title: Lael NDE 6939/899
content:
6939: I experienced an eclamptic [Editor’s note: A form of toxemia of pregnancy.] convulsion the day after I gave birth. It was so severe that my heart stopped. At first, all I experienced was cold, and then my soul floated up out of my body. When I reached the level of the ceiling in my room, I turned around and saw my dead body on the bed. I felt a moment of regret, such as one might feel seeing a beautiful purebred dog dead on the side of the highway. It was a good body and it had served me well, but that part of my existence was over with and I was ready to move on. I did see the medical personnel who were scrambling to resuscitate me and I wished I could tell them not to bother. I turned around, looked up at the ceiling, and floated up into the plenum and through the roof of the building. Once I was outside, I had the feeling that it was night. A shaft of brilliant white light, similar to looking into an aircraft searchlight, pierced the dark sky above me. By contrast, the dark around me was so deep it was palpable. I ‘fell’ upward through that light, but when I reached a threshold, a point of no return, I was stopped. I kept looking into the light. Within it were all the love, beauty, acceptance, and bliss imaginable. How can one describe perfection? I knew God was behind that light and I wanted more than anything to join the beings that I knew were with Him. However, a voice said, ‘Go back. It isn't time.’ The light winked out and I woke up in my body, sick, hurting, and bitterly disappointed. The experience did leave me changed. I will never fear death again. I only wish I could tell everyone that at the end, God handles us gently. There will be only joy when we cross that barrier. The kicker was that the voice that told me to go back. I could never forget the timbre, pace, pitch, and pronunciation I heard. It was the voice my son (a day old at the time of the incident) has now: as a grown man.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Childbirth Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function or brain function) | Yes Surgery-relatedChildbirth Post C-section eclamptic convulsion (status eplipepticus that caused cardiac arrest) Clinical death I guess you could call it that. I was clinically dead with a cardiac arrest until I was resuscitated.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Tunnel | Void | Darkness | Unearthly light | Boundary | Light | Strong emotional tone | Special Knowledge
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I saw my room, my body on the bed, a nurse coming into the room and running back out shouting for help. I saw a doctor responding and running down the hall toward her, but I turned and left before he got in the room. I clearly left my body and existed outside it | Yes My spirit seemed to be a nebulous ball of energy. I still saw and thought and heard but I retained no part of my physical form.
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal
elements.At what time during the experience were: When I was stopped at the threshold and I was still looking into the light: I was in touch with the whole universe, animate and inanimate. | I was probably semiconscious at the start of the event. At any rate, I was groggy but I was not ready to give in to sleep. I remember feeling cold, starting from my feet up, and when the cold hit my chest, my soul left my body and I became fully alert.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning Time as we understand it, stopped for me. | Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning Altered space, maybe. I seemed to be 'falling up' toward the light at an impossibly rapid pace.
elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: I could see everything without looking around and I could focus on everything at once.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: It was the same 360-degree as the vision. I could hear everything without direction and without regard to perception threshold.
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Uncertain I understand why some people perceive a tunnel. To me it was complete black darkness pierced by a white light. I did not feel like it had walls and I think I could have passed through the space to either side of me rather than going to the light but I wanted that light more than anything. | Uncertain It wasn't really a tunnel, although I can see why some people describe it that way. I was in darkness so deep it seemed solid. It was pierced by a blue-white light that had straight sides (think of a WWII aircraft searchlight).
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: No | No Only the voice that told me it was not my time.
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes Brilliant, blue white. But it was not unpleasant to look at directly. It would have been blinding to physical eyes, but I did not have physical eyes any longer. | Yes It was far away to my upper left and extremely brilliant. However, it was not unpleasant to look at. As I explained above, it resembled an old carbon arc aircraft searchlight.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm I was on the brink of God's domain. | No
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: No | Everything about the universe Afterward I started to experience memories of my past lives. It was as if the barrier between past and present had been degraded somehow.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: No | My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you reach a boundary or limiting phy: Yes There is a boundary which, if crossed, prevents you from coming back. I was stopped at that boundary. | Yes My upward 'fall' was stopped abruptly just shy of the light. If I had stepped through it, there would have been no coming back. At that boundary, a voice said, 'Go back. It isn't time.' I never forgot that voice, and strangely, it is the voice that my then day-old son would have as a grown man.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will | I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will I was not involved in the decision. I was told unequivocally that I had to go back. If I experienced any emotion at all, it was just a brief flash of surprise when the voice spoke to me. Then my consciousness winked out and I did not wake up until I was back in my body.
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Have your religious practices changed si: No I am just more firmly convinced of the existence and love of God.
elements.What is your religion now?: Christian- Mormon | Liberal I belong to a Southern Baptist Convention church but I am still a closet liberal
elements.Did your experience include features con: Content that was entirely not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience I had not believed in reincarnation but the experience gave me the knowledge that I have lived before and this life is only one of many my soul has experienced and will experience.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes What we do can matter in ways we do not understand at the time. | Yes Belief in reincarnation.
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Yes I had a sense of continuity telling me I had lived before, died before, and I will do both again.
Yes We are all one in God
Yes I sensed God behind the light. In addition, it was God who told me I had to come back. He spoke to me in my son's voice because He has to communicate with us in terms we will understand.
elements.Concerning our Earthly lives other than: experience? God probably does not exist Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion
elements.Do you believe in an afterlife after you: An afterlife definitely exists Yes I knew that my soul was immortal and it is destined to return to where it came from. God was behind the light I saw and I wanted to return to Him.
elements.Were you fearful living your life prior: Greatly fearful in living my earthly life
elements.Were you fearful living your life after: Slightly fearful in living my earthly life
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Yes I felt overwhelming, accepting love from the light.
elements.What life changes occurred in your life: Large changes in my life Large changes in my life. I became sensitive to my own and others' past lives. I recall many of my own and I can pick up on the significant past lives of others.
elements.Have your relationships changed specific: Uncertain Uncertain I was in an unstable marriage and my life was a mess. It changed a lot, but I'm not certain how much the NDE influenced that.
elements.After the NDE: tionships changed specifically because of your experience? Uncertain Uncertain I was in an unstable marriage and my life was a mess. It changed a lot, but I'm not certain how much the NDE influenced that. After the NDE
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes I am a former English teacher and a writer, but there are simply no words to explain the perfection I saw. It's like trying to explain a color your eyes can't see. | Yes Even though I have an English degree I cannot find words adequate to express the depth of the peace, love, joy, and beauty I saw in that Light.
elements.How accurately do you remember the exper: I remember the experience as accurately as other life events that occurred around the time of the experience I will never forget a single detail. It was too vivid. However, I remember a lot of what went on around it.
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes I can channel others' past lives. I don't do it on a regular basis because unsolicited it's an invasion of privacy. | Yes Over the years I have become more and more aware of several of my past lives. I can also sense past lives of other people.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes I waited a long time because I was afraid people would consider me weird. I'm still careful whom I share it with. Generally speaking people have been accepting. | Yes I have shared parts of it with only a few people closest to me. I know my son does not fear death the way some people do because he knows he has lived before and will live again at God's pleasure. I really can't speak for anyone else. My husband just thinks it's weird.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real It was as real as having breakfast except that it totally blew my mind.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real Absolutely real.
elements.At any time in your life, has anything e: No | No I have been able to leave my body at will but I don't like to do that. It's scary.
elements.Did your hearing differ in any way from: Not particularly. At first I heard the usual sounds of the hospital, and nothing more until the voice told me to go back.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: The best part was knowing that God was behind the light and finding out that He offers unconditional love and infinite peace. The worst part was waking up right back where I had started. My life was such a mess that I was suicidal before the experience. Afterward I knew if I killed myself I would just come back and have to face everything all over again.
elements.Are there any other questions that we co: It seems quite thorough to me.
